reads.stopped_at: The connection begins that process; the entire drive does not need to finish indexing before search becomes available.
reads.what_it_sells: Portway is software that indexes a connected shared drive so I can search its files during my week, beginning after the first folder is indexed.
reads.relevance_feedback: The profile establishes that I signed up as an account administrator and have not connected a drive, so the requested next step is timely. The email additionally presupposes that I manage a shared drive and need another way to search it; neither is established, so the broader fit remains unknown.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I have signed up for Portway and have not yet connected a drive.
Email-only: I have access to a shared drive that I am authorized to connect.
Email-only: searching files through Portway would be useful to me.
Email-only: I am comfortable allowing Portway to index the drive without first seeing its permission and security requirements.
reads.problem_now: Completing setup is relevant to my current account state, but the profile establishes no urgent search problem or deadline. With a meeting in three minutes, connecting a shared drive is not an action I would begin without understanding access and permissions.
reads.biggest_doubt: I do not know what permissions Portway will receive, whether its access is read-only, or what connecting the drive exposes. That matters more than the repeated assurance that search starts before indexing finishes.
reads.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me exactly which drive permissions Portway requests and whether its access is read-only.
fixes: Cut the repetition in "The connection begins that process; the entire drive does not need to finish indexing before search becomes available." The preceding and following paragraphs already make that point.

Replace "The next step starts that background work. Once the first folder finishes indexing, you can use search without waiting for the whole drive." with a concrete explanation of what happens after clicking, including which permissions will be requested and whether access is read-only.
Rewrite "Connect a drive →" to set expectations for the immediate step, such as reviewing the requested permissions before authorizing the connection, if that is in fact how the process works.
reads.persona:
Selected audience (user-stated constraints): A new account administrator who has signed up but has not connected a drive..
Only these audience facts are established. Do not substitute a compiled market segment, invent an installed tool or experience, or infer the campaign's desired reaction. Read the email cold as this person.
